newsitem.title: POLAND: Gunmen rob Latvian coach, kill tourist in Poland.
newsitem.headline: Gunmen rob Latvian coach, kill tourist in Poland.

text.p: Gunmen impersonating police officers held up a Latvian tourist coach in central Poland, killing one of the passengers and making off with $6,000 in cash, PAP news agency said on Sunday.
Three armed men stopped the coach, bound for Germany via Poland, late on Saturday night some 40 km (25 miles) south-west of Warsaw and ordered its driver to head for a nearby forest, the agency said.
While collecting loot from the passengers, the gunmen fired two shots at the ceiling and a third towards the back of the coach, killing a 27-year-old Latvian tourist.

Witnesses said one of the gunmen wore what looked like a German policeman's uniform, while the others were masked, and all spoke Russian. Their Polish-built hatchback had a flashing light like those once used by Poland's police, PAP said. REUTER
